svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Procedure pending the Rev T+ re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev T+ architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Node stations come from tools/cargo_layout_fit.py (single source).
Each node is pouch-wrapped (Faraday) on its saddle or shelf.
Board names: Pilot, TACCO, Observer, Flight Engineer, Commo (2026-08-01 call-sign rename).
The two cargo node saddles bolted to the battery cradle, which is retired. Do not install them until a new mount is designed
